text: Princess Nanaka
Pelulu
Black Peach Ninja
There it is!\nThat's my family's precious heirloom!
Woohoo! Can't wait to get a good look at it~!
Oh my gosh?!
Princess Nanaka, you finally showed up.
When I heard you took over as the leader of the\nLeafy Sakura Clan, I was sure that you'd be after\nthis legendary sword, the "Sakura Storm".
Are you gonna stand in my way? Sakura Storm is a\ntreasure that belongs to the Leafy Sakura Clan.\nIt has nothing to do with the Black Peach Clan.
Hah! We, the Black Peach, have warred over the\nLeafy Sakura since you were still called the White\nPeach. Now is the time for our revenge...
Wait, wait, what's all this about?\nFill us in too!
Those guys are ninjas from the Black Peach Clan.
A few hundred years ago, they fought against our\nancestors for the right to rule the Leafy Sakura.
Our ancestors, who lived on Mt. White Peach at\nthe time, won and later moved to Leafy Sakura\nVillage.
Those from Mt. Black Peach who lost their chance\nhave been harboring a deep resentment toward us to\nthis day.
What? They shouldn't be resenting you, should\nthey?
Hmph! We can't just let you have your way!\nWe'll prove that we should have been the ones to\nrule the Leafy Sakura!
Grrr, just you wait! I'll get you for this!!
Meh, he's all bark and no bite!
Look! This is "Sakura Storm", my family heirloom.\nI have no doubt about it!
It's a legendary sword with a history.\nIt is said that whoever wields it is qualified to\nbe a leader.
Wait, that's it? Only a sword?\nThere are no jewels, gold coins or something like\nthat?
Huh? Yes, there's nothing else...
Welp, it's okay!\nLet's just go to Mt. White Peach now.\nHopefully we'll find something valuable there!
